name: Aloo Gosht
description: Comforting Pakistani meat and potato curry cooked in a flavorful onion-tomato gravy.
ingredients: 750 g beef or mutton, curry cut
4 medium potatoes, peeled and cut into large chunks
2 green chilies and fresh coriander, for garnish
method: Heat oil in a heavy pot and fry the onions over medium heat until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and stir briefly. Add the meat and fry for 5–7 minutes until it changes colour and begins to brown.
Add tomatoes, chili powder, turmeric, coriander, cumin and salt. Cook over medium heat until the tomatoes break down and the oil begins to separate.
Add about 2 cups hot water, cover and simmer gently until the meat is nearly tender. Add more hot water only as needed.
Add the potato chunks and enough hot water for the desired gravy. Cover and cook until both potatoes and meat are fully tender.
Uncover and simmer briefly to adjust the gravy. Taste for salt, garnish with green chilies and coriander, and serve hot.
tips: Do not add potatoes too early or they may break down before the meat becomes tender.
Cook the onion-tomato masala until the raw tomato taste disappears before adding water.
storage: Cool promptly and refrigerate covered for up to 2 days. Reheat until piping hot throughout.
